Policy H3 Residential extensions
Extensions to dwellings will be supported where they are subordinate to the original dwelling in scale, height and massing, respect the character of the street and retain adequate private amenity space.
A two-storey rear extension will be acceptable where it projects no more than 3 m beyond the original rear wall and the eaves height matches the host dwelling.

Side extensions must be set back from the front elevation by at least 1 m and must not create a terracing effect with a neighbouring dwelling. Extensions must not reduce daylight to neighbouring habitable rooms below the standard in the Design SPD.
Policy T2 Parking
New dwellings must provide parking in accordance with the following minimum standards: one space for a dwelling with one or two bedrooms, two spaces for a dwelling with three bedrooms, and three spaces for a dwelling with four or more bedrooms. Each space must measure at least 2.4 m by 4.8 m.

Policy D1 Design quality
Development must achieve high quality design. External materials must complement the predominant palette of the surrounding buildings, and proposals must demonstrate how layout, scale and detailing respond to local character.
Policy G4 Gates and boundaries
Gates, walls and other boundary treatments on a classified road must provide the visibility splay set out in Table 2 of the Design SPD. Gates must open inwards and be set back from the carriageway so that a vehicle can wait clear of the highway. Boundary walls to the front of a dwelling must not exceed 1 m in height.

Monitoring framework
The council will monitor housing delivery, parking provision and design quality annually and report the indicators in the Authority Monitoring Report.

Design SPD
This supplementary planning document explains how the design policies of the Synthetic Local Plan are applied to householder and minor development.

Table 2 Minimum visibility splays
Road type | Speed limit | Splay (x by y)
Classified road | 30 mph | 2.4 m by 43 m
Classified road | 40 mph | 2.4 m by 120 m
Unclassified road | 20 mph | 2.4 m by 25 m
Note: the highway authority may waive the splay where a gate is set back at least 5 m from the carriageway edge and a vehicle can wait clear of the highway.
